tracks.title: Dancing In The Moonlight (It's Caught Me In Its Spotlight)
Johnny The Fox Meets Jimmy The Weed
The Boys Are Back In Town

verdict.detail: Discogs lists 4 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
This release is without Police Street as intro to Jailbreak.
There is an earlier version [with '1Y//1' runout for side A]
with 53 seconds of the track Police Street from

without permission.

There is a version

with a Record One labels variation to this release without Police Street:
• Side A label: The last line of publishing 'M.Co.Ltd./' is placed to the far left, while on this it is placed closer to the Vertigo logo.
• Side B label: Three lines of publishing credits, while on this there are only two.
